prompt: Cinematic film still. In a sterile hospital corridor, the scene is densely populated with distinct figures and items. On the far left, a nurse in blue scrubs stands holding a clipboard, her posture rigid. Next to her, a patient in a striped gown sits slumped on a metal bench, head bowed. A small potted fern rests on the floor beside the bench, its leaves drooping. Centered in the frame, a doctor in a white coat points urgently toward an open elevator door. Inside the elevator, a man in a red scarf looks back with concern. Standing next to the doctor is a woman in a yellow raincoat, clutching a wet umbrella. She is handing a tissue to a crying child in a dinosaur shirt. The child is sitting on the floor, knees pulled to chest. To the right of the child, a brown dog lies calmly on the linoleum, watching the scene. Behind the dog, a janitor in gray overalls pushes a mop bucket, his gaze fixed on the spill nearby. Above them, a flickering fluorescent light buzzes overhead. On the wall to the right, a fire extinguisher hangs in a red cabinet. Next to the extinguisher, a security camera observes from the corner. Leaning against the opposite wall is a tall IV stand with an empty bag. A visitor in a leather jacket stands near the IV stand, checking a wristwatch. Beside the visitor, an elderly woman in a floral dress holds a cane. She is looking at the nurse in blue scrubs. Near the elevator, a delivery person in a brown uniform hands a package to the man in the red scarf. A discarded coffee cup rolls slowly across the floor near the janitor's feet. A second nurse in green scrubs walks past the group, ignoring the chaos. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital clock on the wall.
